response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_per_rating_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_per_rating_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating

assumptions.assumption: The 20.99 cutoff excludes films whose replacement_cost is exactly 20.99.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff includes films whose replacement_cost is exactly 20.99.
